theorems.name: Submission.dohr_translate_varifold
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ), ∃ V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => x - ξ) '' U), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier ∧ (∀ y, V'.mult y = V.mult (y + ξ)) ∧ V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ) ∧ V'.support = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support ∧ ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun y => H (y + ξ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
